instruction.text: Robbie works from home and often leaves his laptop around the house. Which image shows the laptop in a location that could cause electrocution?

atoms.a: Why could the laptop cause electrocution in the bathroom?
b: The laptop could fall into the toilet and block it.

atoms.a: Why is it dangerous to use electrical appliances around water?
b: ++Water conducts electricity, so if you touch water that is touching electricity, you will be electrocuted.
You could slip on a wet floor and break your appliance.

atoms.a: Ralph has just washed his hands. He would like to make a smoothie with his electric blender. He hasn’t dried his hands yet. Is it safe to plug in the blender with wet hands?
Why is it dangerous to use electrical appliances with wet hands?
b: ++Water conducts electricity, so if it comes into contact with an electrical current, you could get electrocuted.
The water could drip onto the floor, and you could slip and drop your appliance.

instruction.text: Decide whether the following act is safe or unsafe.

atoms.a: Using an electrical appliance with wet hands.

atoms.b: It is dangerous to use an electrical appliance with wet hands because water ((++conducts does_not_conduct)) electricity.

instruction.text: Decide whether the following act is safe or unsafe.

atoms.a: Drying your hands thoroughly before using an electrical appliance.
Using electrical appliances close to water.

atoms.b: It is dangerous to use electrical appliances near water as they may get ((++wet dry)), which can cause ((++electrocution a_drought)) or electrical fires.
